diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/facts/test_sysctl.py b/test/units/module_utils/facts/test_sysctl.py

index 0000000..7ad0f5e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/module_utils/facts/test_sysctl.py
@@ -0,0 +1,49 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, patch
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl import get_sysctl, get_uptime_facts
+
+
+def test_sysctl_mixed_lines_and_continuation():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'hw.model: CPU\nbadline\nhw.ncpu = 2\nhw.message first\n  second\n', '')
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {
+        'hw.model': 'CPU', 'hw.ncpu': '2', 'hw.message': 'first\n  second'}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once()
+    assert module.warn.call_args[0][0].startswith('Unable to split sysctl line (badline): ')
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('result', [(1, '', 'failed'), (0, '', ''), (0, 'not numeric', '')])
+def test_uptime_omitted_for_invalid_result(result):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = result
+    assert get_uptime_facts(module) == {}
+
+
+def test_uptime_numeric_boot_time():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, '100\n', '')
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl.time.time', return_value=125):
+        assert get_uptime_facts(module) == {'uptime_seconds': 25}
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with(['/sbin/sysctl', '-n', 'kern.boottime'])
+
+
+def test_missing_sysctl_raises():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        get_uptime_facts(module)
+
+
+def test_failed_sysctl_warns_and_returns_empty():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.side_effect = OSError('unavailable')
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['hw']) == {}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to read sysctl: unavailable')
